recipes.name: Egg Casserole
ingredients_raw: 7 slices white bread, torn into pieces

steps.text: Preheat oven to 350 degrees F (175 degrees C).
Brown sausage in a large skillet over medium-high heat. Drain off grease, and set aside to cool. Pour the eggs into a lightly greased 9x13 inch baking dish.
In a separate large bowl, combine the sausage, bread and 12 ounces of the cheese. Mix well and pour this into the egg mixture. Top with the remaining 4 ounces of cheese and cover with foil.
Bake at 350 degrees F (175 degrees C) for 15 minutes, uncover, and bake until casserole is golden brown and bubbly.

raw_recipe.headline: Egg Casserole
raw_recipe.description: I have been making this egg casserole for 13 years, primarily for Christmas brunch gatherings. It includes eggs, bread, cheese and sausage. It also works great with bacon.

review.reviewBody: The casserole was great! I used 1.5 lbs of bacon instead of the sausage, added three green onions, mixed it all the night before and refrigereated overnight. I baked it at 375 for 40 minutes, the first 15 covered. I took it to a church breakfast, and they loved it! I'll definitely make it again.

The Cook time and Bake time are not correct on this. But once you bake it for long enough it is a really good recipe. You need to brown your sausage or bacon and that takes more than 10 min. to prep it all, so just be prepareed to allow some time. I like to make it at night (prep) and put in fridge overnight so it all soaks in the bread. then take out and back in the morning. I covered with foil for 20 min. then uncovered for 20 min. and that seems to bake perfectly. I used bacon instead and only 12oz. it was very flavorful with that much bacon. also about 1/2 less cheese. Will make again this way.

I made it in a 1/2 batch. In the egg mixture I added a 1/2 tsp of each salt & pepper in a 8" x 8" tin foil pan, cuz our dishwasher was broke down & waiting for a repair person. We tried not to dirty too many dishes. I then added a 1/8 Cup of small cubed pieces of red & green sweet pepper, approx. 3-4 tblsp of finely chopped up green onion (keeping the white part separate from the green ends). I mixed all the white part of the chopped onion & approx. 1/2 of the green tops into the mix with the dry mixture. Once all mixed in the dry goods I proceeded to mix all dry items into the eggs mixture, mixing very well. Top with remaining cheese & sprinkle top lightly with paprika, cover with tin foil, bake following rest of recipe. After we took off film we baked for about another 10-14 minutes until lightly brown on top. We loved i.t

This was a great start to casserole - based on the other reviews I read I changed it a bit but still it was great. I used 8 oz of chorizo, added 1/2 cup milk, used 14 eggs instead of 12 added 1/2 an onion finely chopped and sauted. I would normally use more chorizo but wanted it for flavor not too much spice on this day. I also used sheepherders bread instead of white (4 slices, they are big). I premixed all the ingredients before pouring in the pan. I cooked it in advantium oven so can't speak to normal oven bake times but it was a hit, fed 9 people with some folks having seconds and no leftovers.
I made this into individual serving portions so my family could have a good grab-and-go breakfast! You can also freeze them and pop them into the microwave!

This certainly is an indulgence for us, even though I used Egg Beaters. I scaled down to two servings, took out of the oven at 15 minutes, and it was a little overcooked and dry. If I make again, I’ll start checking for doneness at 11-12 minutes and maybe even add a little milk to the sausage-bread mixture. I’m not convinced that you need that much cheese, so that’s one thing I might try cutting back next time. Used Jimmy Dean hot sausage, added some salt and pepper, and garnished with some chopped parsley. Few ingredients and very easy to make.

Love this recipe! I use it as a base for my egg casseroles. I double the cheese, add in onion (when my husband isn't watching or helping), spinach carrots and add a habenro. Also I mix the meat and bread together, but blend everything else in my Ninja. After I combine everything in my casserole dish I mix it and add my second half of cheese. Today I also added chia seeds, let's see if anyone will notice.

I gave this a 5 bit I did change it some what. I used pre cooked sausage and I cut it up in small cubes then chopped up an onion and took a couple handfuls of those small cubed frozen hash browns and I fired it up for a bit then I spread it evenly over the bread and I broke my cheese grater and had no grated cheese so I cut up some cheddar in small cubes and threw that in. I had to use 14 eggs and some milk to make sure there was enough wet to soak into the bread. I also added some pepper, garlic powder, and a little paprika. It turned out really good. I had some salsa in the fridge and decided to try it with some of the left over and it was even better! very good base to try different things with! I will add peppers and mushrooms next time. and add some shredded cheese to the top. since I was unable to this time.

I loved this casserole! We used 1 lb of turkey sausage and a 1 lb of bacon. We used 6.5 pieces of bread and then we used 13 eggs. We cooked the meat first and then started the rest. We cook it for 15 minutes and remove the foil and cook for an additional 15. Let me tell you, this is great! Make sure you cook the meat- or otherwise the recipe will taste off.

author.name: The Oil Lady from Wauseon, OH

review.reviewBody: Made it with a pound of beef and 1/2 pound of turkey bacon, all browned together in a skillet. Really good and very fast.

I, too, increased to 8 slices of bread and 16 eggs. I added some cheddar, some mozzarella, pepper and some water (I was out of milk) and stirred everything up to a consistency that I thought looked good. My sausage was fully cooked, by the way. Baked at 350 covered for 15 minutes, then finished baking uncovered after that (sorry, didn't keep track of the rest of the time, just brought it out of the oven when it smelled and looked good). I think some people misunderstood the original recipe. Instructions were right as written...bake at 350 for 15 minutes, then uncover and bake until golden and bubbly! A lot of reviewers ripped the poster for the time stating that 15 minutes wasn't enough! Well no kidding, that's not what the instructions stated!! I guess PREP, COOK and READY IN minutes next to the recipe directions are way off, but if you read the recipe you can figure that out. Good food!

My family liked the egg casserole. The casserole would be great to serve for brunch for a crowd because the casserole stays warm. I did add cut up sweet onions and some chopped green chili. Next time, I wll try a hot sausage because we spicy food. You could also add some salsa on top for added heat.
We add 1 1/2 c milk, t mustard, 12 slices of bread. Soak over night. Much thicker feeds more.
It was yummy and very easy to do. Also great for prep. I did it at lunch and ate it at dinner .
Very bland. Essentially breakfast stuffing after following the recipe.
If I substitute bacon for sausage, how much do I use?

Absolutely a keeper. It was so tasty just with the cited ingredients but I added a dollop of sour cream and Mexican salsa onto each serving and that was awesome, too. I used 2 lbs of sausage because I didn't want to freeze the extra half a pound (and, of course, I'm a hog). I also used buttermilk bread which is white and has a nice flavor.
I made it all vegetarian. I added tomatoes, mushrooms, onions and spinach. It was hit at the office party

It was very good. We added shallots and used turkey sausage. I like that it didn’t need to sit 8 hours before baking like my other egg casserole recipe. We adjusted the oven temp up 25 degrees because we are on the edge of high elevation. I’ll make this again.

Not a fan. I actually followed the recipe exactly (except I stored it in the fridge overnight and cooked it longer.). It’s really dry. I don’t know if me cooking it twice as long did that. I took it out as soon as it got golden brown. It was easy and edible but nothing I’d make again.
